overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: interviews showed no private deliberation on the June 27 topics, and the referenced May 16 meeting was a misspoken date for the noticed May 9 meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee privately deliberated on its June 27 meeting topics, since the discussion at the meeting seemed too brief.
allegations.key_passage: Based on our interviews with the Committee members, we find no evidence that the Committee deliberated privately about any of the topics listed on the June 27 meeting notice.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee referred to a May 16 meeting that was never noticed under the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: Furthermore, the meeting date of May 16 referenced during the June 27 meeting was a mistake.
